profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) was founded in 2020 and operates as a not-for-profit government lab. Its site describes it as a leading global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. TII presents Falcon LLM as a generative large language model intended to make advanced AI accessible, and it has announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models. The site also references AI71, a company launched by the Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne.

TII's Falcon line includes Falcon-H1, Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, Falcon Arabic, Falcon H1R 7B, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon 40B, and Falcon 10B. The site claims Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. It also states Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, and Falcon 40B has 40 billion parameters trained on one trillion tokens. Falcon (TII) is described as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with Apache 2.0 licensing, sovereign AI positioning, and Middle East data residency.
